name.description: Name uniquely identifies the name among all rules

display_name.description: 'display_name' is a human-readable display name for the rule

skip.description: 'skip' allows the creation of rules that are skipped.  Deprecated, used 'skip_expression' instead.

skip_expression.description: 'skip_expression' is a template expression that is evaluated to determine if the item should be skipped.

skip_reason.description: 'skip_reason' is a human-readable reason for why the item is skipped.  This will be logged at INFO level in the report, if the item is skipped.

priority.description: priority defines the order in which the rule is evaluated.  If not provided then it sorts last

description.description: 'description' is a human-readable description of the rule

required_contexts.description: 'required_contexts' is a list of contexts that are required for the rule to run.  Deprecated, used 'skip_expression' instead.

annotations.description: 'annotations' are a map of key-value pairs that are used to store additional information about the rule

classifications.description: 'classifications' are the classifications of the rule as an array of strings.

Record.description: Record is a single log record.

version.description: 'version' defines the parsing of the spec

metadata.description: 'metadata' is the metadata for the object

spec.description: 'spec' is the specification for the report

Report.description: Report is the final result of the remediation that is filled out during the remediation.

path.description: 'path' is the path to the file

metadata.description: 'metadata' is the metadata for the rule

name.description: 'name' is the name of the rule

skipped.description: 'skipped' is true if the rule was skipped

skip_reason.description: 'skip_reason' is the reason the rule was skipped

findings.description: 'findings' is the number of findings found for the rule

fixes.description: 'fixes' is the number of fixes applied for the rule

changes.description: 'changes' is the total number of changes applied for the rule.  In many cases a remediation requires more then one change

errors.description: 'errors' is a collection of all the errors that were encountered for the rule

error_count.description: 'error_count' is the number of errors that were encountered for the rule

logs.description: logs is a list of all log messages.

logs_count.description: logs_count is the number of log messages.

files.description: 'files' is a collection of all the files that were processed for the rule

file_count.description: 'file_count' is the number of files that were processed for the rule

paths_with_findings.description: 'paths_with_findings' is a map of file paths to a struct indicating that the file had findings

files_changed.description: 'files_changed' is a map of file paths to a struct indicating that the file was changed

hooks.description: 'hooks' is a map of hook names to their details

workspace.description: 'workspace' is the path to the workspace that was remediated

language.description: 'language' is the language of the workspace that was remediated

rules_applied.description: 'rules_applied' is the number of rules that were applied

rules_skipped.description: 'rules_skipped' is the number of rules that were skipped

findings.description: 'findings' is the number of findings found during the audit

fixes.description: 'fixes' is the number of fixes that were applied

changes.description: 'changes' is the total number of changes applied.  In many cases a remediation requires more then one change

files_changed.description: 'files_changed' is a map of file paths to a struct indicating that the file was changed

errors.description: 'errors' is a collection of all the errors that were encountered

logs.description: logs is a list of all log messages.

logs_count.description: logs_count is the number of log messages.

error_count.description: 'error_count' is the number of errors that were encountered

rules.description: 'rules' is a collection of all the rules that were applied in order

hooks.description: 'hooks' is a map of hook names to their details
